integrity: Full GF2 enumeration supported by an exact algebraic geometric-smoothness test and independent Groebner checks of orbit representatives. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact for smooth plane quartics over F2 only; counts projective equations/orbits, not absolute isomorphism classes. Historical classification may conceal an equivalent implicit spectrum.
title: Exact rational-line Bertini spectrum of smooth plane quartics over \(\mathbf F_2\)
